additional_info.subject: Issue Description
additional_info.body:
Hello, We replaced the PT on this charger last week, but we weren’t even able to establish a proper connection. We ran a test the same day: when selecting the payment option on the charger, the card reader powered on, but didn’t respond or read any card, you can refer to the attached video for reference
We’ve also noticed that the PT hasn’t sent any heartbeat signal since the day after the replacement, which suggests that it may be disconnected. I shared the logs with CCV, but they weren't sufficient. According to their feedback, this may point to a hardware issue with the terminal, preventing it from generating or retrieving logs correctly. If the PT is completely unreachable and no logs can be collected, a replacement is likely necessary, as this is not expected behavior from functional hardware. Could you please confirm and let us know? If a replacement is needed, kindly proceed with it.TID:40800450
Thank you

additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
Site intervention will be necessary to resolve the issue.
Kindly follow the troubleshooting steps:
Verify Ports
: Check that the correct ports are being used to connect the CORA10 to the OPM-C60.
Inspect Cable Connections
: Ensure the cable connection between the Processing Unit and the Card Reader is secure.
Reconnect Cables
: Reconnect all cables and restart the charger.
Replace CORA10
: If the issue persists or if the CCV is broken, please consider exchanging the CORA10(payment terminal).
MLFB of CORA10:
8EM5903-0AA02-7AA1 -PZ2 Credit Card Reader CCV Contactless
